name: Felucca SMK
description: Go deep into synthesis. Shape a sound, find a new favorite, and turn a small keyboard into a much bigger instrument.

name: Sloop SMK
description: Start with a beat. Layer synths, build patterns, and keep the ideas moving with a performance-minded groovebox.

name: Melodee SMK
description: Explore Prophet, FM6, CZ-1, SID and drums on your SMK, in the native browser Studio or simulator. Experimental hardware beta.

name: Doom FM-1 / SMK
description: Play nine original Doom levels with weapons, music and a classic HUD. SMK release 24 adds illuminated drum-pad controls, press-to-dark feedback and Fader 2 brightness. FM-1 release 26 adds GameDude-style illuminated controls and more responsive input scanning. The installer also restores original firmware; the SMK Pro round trip is verified.
artAlt: Black SMK-37 playing Doom, with cyan movement pads, amber strafe, green Use and red Fire
heroAlt: Black SMK-37 playing Doom, with cyan movement pads, amber strafe, green Use and red Fire

name: GameDude FM-1 / SMK
description: Turn your FM-1, SMK-37 Pro or Elite into a pocket arcade. Install once, then build your Game Boy library over Bluetooth or USB. Pick a saved game and play.
heroAlt: GameDude on FM-1, SMK-37 Pro and Elite with Breakout gameplay
artAlt: SMK-37 Pro playing Breakout, with an enlarged display inset
screenshotAlt: GameDude browser player showing Breakout in its classic green handheld shell
previewDescription: Classic green. Familiar controls. Try the included Breakout homebrew, then choose FM-1, Pro, Elite or handheld controls in the player.

name: GameDude Color FM-1 / SMK
description: The pocket arcade, in full color. Play Game Boy Color games on FM-1, SMK-37 Pro or Elite, with Bluetooth and USB uploads, multiple saved games and a browser player.
heroAlt: GameDude Color on FM-1, SMK-37 Pro and Elite with Flooder gameplay
artAlt: SMK-37 Pro playing Flooder, with an enlarged full-color display inset
screenshotAlt: GameDude Color browser player showing Flooder mid-game in its Atomic Purple handheld shell
previewDescription: Atomic Purple, full-color play. Try Flooder, the included color puzzle game, with the same FM-1, Pro, Elite and handheld controls.

name: NESynth FM-1 / SMK
description: Drop in a NES ROM or ZIP, or try the included homebrew games. Play in your browser and build and flash FM-1 firmware over USB. SMK37 simulators and development builds are also available.
